protocol.sampling: 8 independent conditional future suffixes per state; common across four branches, plus original suffix audit
protocol.information_boundary: Full suffixes saved offline only; every online call uses known_clone
protocol.timing_rule: First review may be interrupted by legitimate events, using same continuation policy
protocol.strata: Primary: just unloaded (15 states); supplement: other departure-ready states. No reserved load is abandoned.

capture_audit.note: Exclusion reasons can overlap. Post-unload states are the primary layer; other departure-ready states are reported separately.

uncertainty.per_state: Eight independent suffix draws conditioned on one observed state; t7 intervals are exploratory.
uncertainty.multiple_comparisons: No correction for testing many states or three intervals.
uncertainty.rare_events: Eight draws may miss rare gains; all-negative draws do not prove waiting is never useful.
uncertainty.selection: Choosing the best interval/state by these same sample means is optimistic; not an independent test.
uncertainty.shared_prefixes: State-level means share original day/layout prefixes; no iid pooling across states.
uncertainty.time_cost: Extra truck_time is the difference in whole-fleet whole-day time cost, not merely the first dwell cost.
uncertainty.overlap: Idle-drone ready/loadable overlap is an optimistic time bound, not a certificate of jointly feasible service or a necessary condition for positive whole-day gain: waiting can shift later station visits and consolidation.
